messages:
maya: Quick update — Orpheus9b bench complete. Need short recommendation for GTN: default int8 vs opt-in int4 routing. Keep it action-oriented.

diego: Smoke highlights: p95 int8=120ms, int4=110ms. Unit-cost est: int8 ~$0.0009/token, int4 ~$0.0006/token (batched).

lina-qa: QA: longform (>512 tokens) EM drops ~6.4pt on int4, hallucination +2.1ppt. Short snippets (<=64) show ~0.4pt EM diff.
sam: Recommendation: default to int8. Offer int4 as opt-in for short, low-risk flows to capture cost savings. Canary int4 at 5% on targeted slices.
maya: Can someone draft a tiny routing flag we can hand to infra? Minimal fields only.
diego: Proto snippet (plain text):

routes:
- id: short_optin
  match: tokens <= 64 and flow == "low_cost"
  model: orpheus9b-int4
  sample_rate: 0.05
- id: default
  model: orpheus9b-int8
  sample_rate: 0.95

fallbacks:
- from: orpheus9b-int4
  to: orpheus9b-int8
  triggers: [quality_drop, latency_spike]

maya: ops-bot confirm canary window?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled to eng-dedicated-orpheus tomorrow 03:00 UTC for 2h. Auto-rollback if >2% EM regression on any slice or >20% p95 latency increase.

lina-qa: Test plan: slices = short snippets, multi-turn (history 3), longform QA. Metrics: EM, hallucination, p95, token-cost delta. AB 24h, alert on EM drop >2%.

sam: If longform gap persists, try KV-cache warmstarts and a mixed-per-layer quant trial (keep first/last layers int8).
maya: OK — diego open PR for routing flag, lina post CSV after overnight run, I'll monitor canary and call rollback if needed. Thanks :thumbsup:
